notes.title: 关服公告
notes.notes:
[h1]关服公告[/h1]

游戏将于2024年9月15日正式终止运营，届时将关闭所有服务器后玩家将无法登陆游戏。感谢您一直以来的支持与陪伴！ 我们会继续努力，在将来为您带来更好的作品！

notes.title: 2023年圣诞季更新日志
notes.notes:
1. 为迎接2024年，此赛季战斗通行证奖励加量
2. 公共聊天功能开启，可通过定制信息模板交流。点击主页面右上角的聊天按钮打开聊天窗口
3. 添加加速动画功能，玩家可将加速对战动画演示。该功能在游戏设置中开关。

notes.title: 2023/10/25 更新日志
notes.notes:
游戏更新： 
1. 添加快捷键，可用退格键结束当前回合
2. 游戏内市场添加2个随机装备箱
3. 添加公告系统
4. 礼品码兑换后提供获得道具信息提示
5. 微调装备窗口和工具提示 
有任何问题，欢迎与我们交流~ 
感谢关注并喜爱《全球戒备》的朋友们。

notes.title: 《全球戒备》参展2023蒸汽平台鉴赏家大会，还有开发者直播等你来看！
notes.notes:
2023蒸汽平台鉴赏家大会再度开启！近300款精品游戏参与，四十余款游戏将在发布会上带来备受关注的重磅新内容，将在国内蒸汽平台和Steam平台上正式呈现。《全球戒备》也已参展确定，[b]9月22日18:00~20:00[/b]还将有《全球戒备》开发者直播，欢迎来观看！

notes.title: 2023/8/29 Update Log
notes.notes:
Game updates:
1. Increased money rewards for all missions
2. Adjusted avatar prices and weapon decal prices.
3. put time limit on pvp mode, only open at 19-24pm
4. Season 2 Battle Pass updated with more avatars and weapons not available in the store.

Season 2 pass is now open, friends can join in together to win more rewards! In addition, if you have any questions about the pvp time limit or other adjustments, please feel free to come to the QQ group [200171742] to communicate with us.
Thank you for your attention and love.

notes.title: Prepare for battle and strategize against each other at the Steam Strategy Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44275653/ec9292ebd7f7502f82c04bea04b1614f9f6b3cf4.jpg[/img]
Greetings, friends! It's been almost a month since the game's release, and we're wondering how you're enjoying it. As a member of the strategy category, we are honored to join the Steam Strategy Fest!
The wargame strategy gameplay based on bunker shooting, together with the sense of command of military tactics, highlights the strategic at the same time, as well as PVP real-time confrontation, which really makes the battle on the big map unpredictable, tense and exciting!

Immediately enter the battlefield, with us, to a strategic depth of strength competition!

If you have any questions about the game, you are welcome to come to the group [200171742] to communicate with us.
Thank you for your attention and love.

notes.title: 2023/8/18 Updated Log
notes.notes:
1. fixed the bug of no vip rewards on normal and hard difficulty pve levels and set rewards
2. lowered the difficulty of the training ground in pvp wait mode.

Currently adjusted point 2 for everyone's suggestions, but by watching the KOL's live, found that the difficulty is still a bit high, you can give us more suggestions, we will continue to adjust according to your proposals. If you have any questions or suggestions, communicate with us anytime please. 
Thank you for your attention and love.

notes.title: 2023/8/12 Updated Log
notes.notes:
1. fixed the problem that vip and battle pass payment can't be accounted for.
2. fixed in-game text and display errors
3. fixed the issue that Legion items can't be purchased in the store.

The game has been released on Early Access for more than a week, thanks for your attention and love. We will update the game with any bugs that we can fix in time. If you have any questions or suggestions, communicate with us anytime please. 
We wish you all a happy weekend.
